description: Notification sent to a student when they have been nominated (or self-nominated) as a candidate in a Student Union election.
subject: You have been nominated for $position
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to confirm that you have been nominated as a candidate in the Student Union election for the following position:

Election Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Position:        $position
Election ID:     $election_id
Date Nominated:  $date_nominated
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Your Manifesto:
$manifesto_preview

What happens next:
• Your candidacy will be visible to voters once the election enters its voting phase.
• You may submit campaign materials for review through the Student Union office.
• Campaign expenses are capped at £100; track receipts and submit them as you incur costs.
• If you wish to withdraw your candidacy, contact the Elections Committee as soon as possible.

For questions about the election, candidate guidelines, or campaign rules, please contact the Student Union Elections Committee.

Good luck with your campaign!

Kind regards,
Student Union Elections Committee
University Administration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
